BPSC 71st Mains Result 2026 – Full Details

Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released the Mains Result for the post of 71st Combined Competitive Examination Preliminary Examination 2026. This recruitment was released for 1298 posts. Applications for the BPSC 71st Mains Online Form 2025 were accepted from 03 December 2025 to 24 December 2025. The mains examination was held from 25-30 April 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their BPSC 71st Mains Result 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 02 June 2025
  • Last Date : 30 June 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 June 2025
  • Exam Date : 13 September 2025
  • Admit Card : 06 September 2025
  • Answer Key : 06 September 2025
  • Final Answer Key : 31 October 2025
  • Pre Result : 18 November 2025
  • Mains Online Form
  • Start Date : 03 December 2025
  • Last Date : 24 December 2025
  • Mains Exam Date : 25-30 April 2026
  • Mains Admit Card : 17 April 2026
  • Mains Result : 11 November 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS, Other Candidates : Rs. 600/-
  • SC, ST, Female Candidates of Bihar : Rs. 150/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 150/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
